items.title: CME Group (CME) Is Emerging As A Key Voice In Crypto Regulation
items.summary: CME Group (NasdaqGS:CME) took part in a White House crypto summit alongside major financial institutions, underscoring its role in US digital asset policy discussions. The company featured in talks on regulatory frameworks for crypto markets, highlighting its engagement beyond traditional futures and options. At a recent CFTC meeting, CME Group's CEO publicly challenged a prediction market competitor, focusing on market integrity and regulatory standards. The twin events put CME Group at the...

items.title: Tensions Flare as CME, Kalshi Execs Clash Over Prediction Markets in DC
items.summary: CME Group Chairman Terry Duffy and Kalshi co-founder Luana Lopes Lara traded barbs during a CFTC meeting over prediction markets, manipulation, and regulatory standards.

items.title: CFTC Committee Discussion on Prediction Markets Gets Heated
items.summary: A Commodity Futures Trading Commission Innovation Advisory Committee meeting got heated Thursday, with some members raising concerns that prediction-market platforms could be susceptible to insider trading and expressing worry over markets listed.  Terry Duffy, chief executive of exchange operator CME Group, said that some markets being listed could be manipulated.

items.title: CME Group CEO Terry Duffy Clashes With CFTC Chair Over Prediction Markets
items.summary: CME CEO Terry Duffy says the CFTC waves through manipulable prediction markets. Chairman Selig called the claim fake news.

items.title: DRW’s Don Wilson Encourages CFTC to Approve Perpetual Futures
items.summary: Don Wilson, founder of high-speed trading giant DRW, said Thursday that he was encouraging the Commodity Futures Trading Commission to approve perpetual futures contracts on a wide range of products, including those linked to single stocks.  Speaking at the CFTC Innovation Advisory Committee’s inaugural meeting, Wilson said he views perpetual futures contracts as “a very useful risk-management tool.”  Perpetual futures contracts, also known as perps, are a type of derivative that never expires and trades 24/7.

items.title: Coinbase Global Stock Carries A Premium Multiple And A Shrinking Top Line
items.summary: The premium rests on a three-year growth average, while the most recent reported quarter went the other way.

items.title: Oil Cracks $89 As Trump Launches 'Economic D-Day' Vs. Iran
items.summary: Crude oil prices rose to nearly a one-month high on Thursday morning after President Donald Trump announced the "most crushing economic operation ever undertaken," regarding Iran, in a Wednesday evening Truth Social post.  The Dow industrials, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all opened lower as Treasury yields rebounded.  Beyond the blockade of Iran's Persian Gulf ports, Trump vowed harsh consequences for countries that provide "any type of lifeline to Iran" via government entities, financial institutions, airports, front companies and oil smuggling.

items.title: U.S. Markets Prepare For AI Compute Derivatives Tied To TSMC, Nvidia GPU Prices
items.summary: Regulators took initial steps to allow investors to trade AI compute futures based on the prices of GPUs sold by the likes of Nvidia, TSMC and Broadcom.
